title: gypsophila cretica
intro: Gypsophila cretica, commonly known as Cretan baby's breath, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Gypsophila cretica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Research on this plant is limited, but it is thought to exhibit sedative and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
